title: RAW ar/aiin property nouns with one HAS lifting and one predicate negation
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Independent extension of537's literal quality seed: ar=HEAT, aiin=MOISTURE; d lifts either quality to a subject/state predicate. qo negates either resulting predicate. All exact occurrences, outside lines and owner gaps retained.

Fourfold year/life analogy is not identity. Every person contains all elements; one may predominate. Quality opposition, constitution naming and appropriate intervention are distinct relations.

d.law: HAS(q)(x,s) means the quality q is predicated of subject x in state s. No numeric intensity, predominance, remedy or automatic person is supplied.

qo.type: (Subject x State -> Bool) -> (Subject x State -> Bool)
qo.law: NOT(P)(x,s) = not P(x,s), same x and s.

design.writer_limits: Exactly four compound licenses plus two bare atoms. No d or qo standalone token is claimed; no other substring is decomposed. qodain, qo@152;ar and marked variants remain distinct unbound forms.
distinct_consequences: For one fixed owner/state, dar and qodar cannot both be asserted; the independent daiin/qodaiin cell gives the same exclusion.
Bare ar/aiin are Quality objects, not assertions: each bare occurrence needs a written relation accepting Quality. Replacing a naked aiin by 'is moist' would violate this new type contract.
owner_grammar_needed: Every dar/daiin/qodar/qodaiin occurrence must acquire an explicit written owner and state from a declared grammar, not from an illustration or unspoken block role.
Every ar/aiin noun requires a typed argument position, including .1 and .24. N.2 has or or aiin, W.20 differs or/ar, and IT W.22 has fused aiinog. No generic filler use.
N.4 chol daiin, E.9 initial daiin, S.15 dar, S.16/W.21 qodaiin and E.10 qodar must all survive whole-block grammar without moving predicates between people.
design.source_pressure: All-element membership does not by itself assert all four quality predicates. If a later full draft adds the implication that every fire-containing person thereby HAS(HEAT), then any NOT(HAS(HEAT)) assertion about such a person at the same state conflicts. Do not rescue that clash by silently changing HAS to PREDOMINATES or by treating NOT-HOT as a cooling prescription.

rivals.name: PREDOMINATES lifting
rivals.contract: Use d(q)(x,s)=quality q predominates in x at s; keep the same two atom meanings and one qo negation. This may coexist with membership of every element but makes a stronger ranking claim. No per-cell choice between HAS and PREDOMINATES.

rivals.name: RAW537 predicate-only seed
rivals.contract: dar/daiin remain independent predicates and ar/aiin unbound. It has fewer type constraints; compare cost honestly rather than crediting the additional bare meanings as already proved.

design.falsifier: A completed all-loci reading that forces any literal noun into a predicate-only slot, uses d as HAS for one cell but predominance for the other, or asserts P and NOT(P) for one written owner/state defeats this specific contract. Literal co-occurrence alone cannot establish that failure while owners are unbound.
